title: Got a lot of hate for the Steam AI disclosure on my Peggle x Balatro roguelike, and somehow it was still my best wishlist day
author: LoopLogicGames
selftext:
I posted my trailer in the Peggle sub yesterday (a community that is near and dear to me as a Peggle fan since 2008), and most of the comments ended up being about the AI disclosure on my Steam page. A few people said they won’t support the game because of it. I tried to be level-headed about the whole thing and give my perspective without any hostility. Even with all that, the post turned into my best wishlist day so far. 

Has anyone else here had a genre sub turn on them over the Steam AI disclosure?

[STARZ.PEG on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5160100/STARZPEG/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launchpost) (Demo available)

comments.author: smashbro64
comments.body:
Look great. The art direction is strong and is familiar without feeling like a peggle clone. Trailer is well put together too. 

Only suggestion for a change is the name. “Starz.Peg” sounds like a file name and not the name of a game. Something more friendly and fun could work better. 

Nice job buddy
